lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in roughly vertical clusters; individual centroids show varying pixel radii, forming an organized array across the lateral surface posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, creating identifiable anchor nodes within a sparse grid structure across the central posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of high-luminance pixels on the superior edge and a shadowed inferior boundary.
